title: AI Engineering
description: A high-level learning path from ML foundations to building, evaluating and maintaining AI-powered applications.

stages.title: Establish ML foundations
stages.description: Understand supervised learning, optimization and model training.

stages.title: Learn modern model tooling
stages.description: Study transformer concepts, model APIs and data workflows.

stages.title: Explore language-model engineering
stages.description: Connect language-model fundamentals to application patterns.

stages.title: Read advanced material
stages.description: Follow research seminars and framework documentation as your projects become more demanding.

title: Computer Science Foundations
description: Move from introductory programming to algorithms, architecture and software correctness.

stages.title: Start with a broad introduction
stages.description: Learn core programming ideas and computational problem solving.

stages.title: Understand structure and abstraction
stages.description: Explore discrete reasoning, formal methods and the mathematical basis of software.

stages.title: See the machine underneath
stages.description: Study how logic, architecture, operating systems and software layers connect.

stages.title: Practise and extend
stages.description: Strengthen implementation skills and collaborative development habits.

title: Electronics Foundations
description: A theory-first route through circuits, digital concepts and the documentation used in electronic design.

stages.title: Learn circuit fundamentals
stages.description: Study voltage, current, components and circuit models.

stages.title: Explore digital and hardware concepts
stages.description: Read the documentation to understand electronic design workflows and terminology.

stages.title: Explore chip-design concepts
stages.description: Use technical documentation to understand the stages and vocabulary of digital chip implementation.

title: Game Development Foundations
description: A flexible route from programming basics to a small playable project. Choose one engine first; you do not need to learn every engine at once.

stages.title: Build the programming foundation
stages.description: Review variables, functions, control flow, data structures and debugging. For browser games, start with JavaScript; for Python-based 2D work, explore Python and Pygame; for engine-based development, learn the language used by your chosen engine.

stages.title: Choose one engine
stages.description: Pick an engine based on the kind of project you want to make. Read its official documentation alongside a guided tutorial.

stages.title: Build one small complete game
stages.description: Start with a tiny scope: one mechanic, one level, a clear start and end, and a simple interface. Use a tutorial as a guide, then modify the result so that you understand the code and design choices.

stages.title: Explore graphics and game mathematics
stages.description: After completing a simple game, explore vectors, transforms, interpolation, collision concepts and rendering.

stages.title: Learn from the wider game-development community
stages.description: Use conference talks and independent development diaries to understand design trade-offs, production planning and how teams build games.

title: Independent Research Skills
description: Build the habits needed to explore a technical question, understand evidence and keep a reproducible record.

stages.title: Form a strong foundation
stages.description: Strengthen conceptual understanding in the subject you want to investigate.

stages.title: Read technical literature
stages.description: Move from textbooks to course notes and selected research reading.

stages.title: Use computational tools
stages.description: Explore how software, data and computation support investigation.

stages.title: Document what you learn
stages.description: Track ideas, versions, assumptions and evidence carefully.

title: Machine Learning Foundations
description: A prerequisite-aware route into machine learning, from mathematics and statistics to model implementation.

stages.title: Prepare the mathematics
stages.description: Review linear algebra, calculus, probability and statistics.

stages.title: Learn core ML methods
stages.description: Use an introductory text, then progress to a rigorous university course.

stages.title: Build practical skills
stages.description: Implement and experiment with deep-learning models.

stages.title: Explore modern model families
stages.description: Study transformer-based approaches and open model tooling.

title: Mathematics Foundations
description: A flexible sequence from mathematical language and algebra toward calculus, linear algebra and proof.

stages.title: Start with core fluency
stages.description: Build comfort with algebraic manipulation, functions and the meaning of mathematical notation.

stages.title: Develop visual intuition
stages.description: Use visual explanations and interactive models to form mental pictures of abstract ideas.

stages.title: Study university mathematics
stages.description: Choose a focused course or textbook sequence for linear algebra and calculus.

stages.title: Learn mathematical proof
stages.description: Practise definitions, statements, proof structure and discrete reasoning.

title: Physics Foundations
description: Pair clear conceptual reading with university lectures and visual experiments.

stages.title: Build the core picture
stages.description: Use an introductory text and simulations to explore physical relationships.

stages.title: Study mechanics
stages.description: Follow a structured mechanics sequence and solve its exercises.

stages.title: Connect concepts across topics
stages.description: Use deeper lecture material to develop a broader understanding.

title: Programming from Zero
description: A beginner-friendly route into programming, computational thinking and independent practice.

stages.title: Choose a first language
stages.description: Begin with introductory programming and core problem-solving habits.

stages.title: Practise consistently
stages.description: Use short exercises and structured tracks to reinforce concepts.

stages.title: Learn developer workflows
stages.description: Understand version control and explore browser technologies when ready.

stages.title: Build deeper systems understanding
stages.description: Connect programs with the computer systems that execute them.
